callGraph.callee:
borrows.annotate(day=TruncDate("requested_at"))
            .values("day")
            .annotate(
                total=Count("id"),
                returned=Sum(
                    Case(
                        When(status="returned", then=1),
                        default=0,
                        output_field=IntegerField(),
                    )
                ),
            )
            .order_by
